verdict.rationale: Twilio's own docs show it can record calls programmatically and offers an API for account-wide default recording settings. A community user corroborates using it for voicemail-to-webhook with transcription. Nothing in the evidence covers jurisdiction-specific consent handling or how recordings are stored, searched or retrieved later. Missing for 10: consent/announcement handling per jurisdiction, recording retrieval/search capability, in-depth recording docs.
